title: This version of the installer can't install on this phone model
body: This release is for the Pixel 7 Pro (panther). This version of the installer writes only to: cheetah.

An install ends by making slot B the phone's active slot. What that costs, and what the phone falls back to when a start fails, differ from model to model, and for this model they have not been worked into this installer.
A dry run works for this phone. To install, use the installer that comes with the release (https://omamobile.org/download), or ask at https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: Nothing was sent to a phone.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
